logistic.refit: at each season start on every labelled example from earlier seasons; features are the pregame snapshots captured at predict time

efficiency.possessions: FGA - OREB + TOV + 0.44*FTA per team, mean of both teams
efficiency.missing_data: latest complete observation among those delivered; incomplete observations are counted and ignored

definition.delivery: a box score is used only when both its own availability and its game's result availability are at or before the generation time
definition.cutoff: 00:00 America/New_York on the game's Eastern date; the forecast must be generated before it

stale_inputs.rule: no shadow forecast is recorded for a game if either team lacks a complete delivered box score for any of its most recent finals of the current season (results available at generation time); the skip is reported and a later run may record it. Older gaps are tolerated and counted.

promotion_rule.decision_set: regular-season and play-in games where frozen Elo and the candidate each have a live forecast generated before the cutoff, and a final result; games missing either forecast are excluded and counted
promotion_rule.comparison: paired per-game Brier difference (candidate - Elo); ISO-week block bootstrap, seed 20260930, 2000 resamples
promotion_rule.promote_if: interval upper bound < 0 AND candidate log loss <= Elo log loss
promotion_rule.applied: once, after the last play-in game; interim reports are operational only and never used for decisions
baselines_reported: DraftKings via ESPN, latest quote retrieved no later than the forecast's generated_at, proportional de-vig, coverage reported
promotion_rule.market: reported alongside; does not affect promotion
promotion_rule.changes: none mid-season; a changed definition is a new model_version, reported separately

screening.rule: Brier below Elo's and paired 95% upper bound of (candidate - Elo) Brier < 0.001; at most 2 by lowest validation Brier
screening.note: screening on validation seasons only; not evidence of improvement
